top_signals.title: Anthropic IPO Explained: Nasdaq Listing and Key Risks
top_signals.summary: In late 2020, a group of senior OpenAI employees unhappy with what they saw as the company’s failure to adequately prioritize AI ethics and safety left the firm to form Anthropic PBC. Just a few years later, the younger company has become an artificial intelligence behemoth that is expected to hold one of the largest initial public offerings in history.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Anthropic Lodges Australian Prospectus, Opening IPO to Retail
top_signals.summary: Australian retail investors are able to buy shares of Anthropic PBC in the artificial intelligence giant’s initial public offering, which targets a valuation of $1.4 trillion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: OpenTable CEO on 2027 Dining Trends Report
top_signals.summary: OpenTable CEO Debby Soo says diners continue to value restaurant experiences despite economic pressures, with Gen Z especially inclined to go out for celebrations and smaller special occasions. The 2027 dining trends report says 68% of diners expect to eat out the same amount or more, rising to 88% among Gen Z. Soo speaks with Vonnie Quinn & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
